Burn-down complete (--status approved). 4 of 5 shipped; 1 held for your decision.

Completed (merged + auto-bumped):
- STORY-608 Glossary chapter generated from 'aida docs glossary' — PR #856
- STORY-609 lifecycle diagram split into 5 focused diagrams + styling standard — PR #857
- BUG-535 'aida human' now appends titles beside SPEC-IDs (reused BUG-532 helper) — PR #859
- STORY-600 'aida manual <cmd>' prints the CLI-manual rationale section — PR #860

HELD for you (NOT merged) — needs a decision:
- STORY-603 doc-intent gate — PR #858 is a DRAFT and adds a NEW CI enforcement step (verify-interface-changes.py: surface-changing specs must populate interface_changes OR carry docs:impacted, else CI fails). Two reasons I didn't auto-merge: (1) implementer opened it as draft; (2) it's CI infrastructure that will start gating every future cli.rs/skill-set PR — warrants a human eyeball before it's live. Implementer shipped only part 1 and filed parts 2-4 as follow-ups TASK-794/795/796 (now in awaiting_signoff, unqueued). Your call: review+ready+merge, or send back.

Caveats worth noting:
- Integrated-main verify was a compile check only (cargo build -p aida-cli, passed). BUG-535 + STORY-600 both touched cli.rs; combined main builds clean.
- STORY-603's held worktree (agent-a1a0f7f651db6c2e5) was correctly NOT pruned (unmerged). It carries a harmless local-only 'scratch-gate-test' branch the git-guardrail hook blocked from deletion; never pushed.

Parked by the gate (untouched): TASK-735, TASK-751 (deferred:on-demand), TASK-749 (deferred:future-rbac), SPIKE-60 (deferred:design).
Worktrees pruned cleanly: 4 (the merged specs).
